about snowball sprint

snowball sprint turns paying something off into a little winter story. split your target into boxes, tick one off each time you put a chunk towards it, and a new snow scene appears every 10% of the way. choose your palette in settings to make it feel like yours. there's no pressure and no streaks: slow weeks are just information. everything stays privately in this browser.

  1. name what you're paying off and set a target amount.
  2. choose how many boxes to split it into (50, 100 or 200).
  3. optionally set a target date to see a gentle pace check.
  4. press shuffle if you'd like the boxes in a different order.
  5. tap a box when you've paid a chunk and add the amount and date.
  6. every 10% unlocks a scene. find them all in the gallery tab.
